NULL THEN s.arranger ELSE t.arranger END, producer = CASE WHEN s.producer IS NOT NULL THEN s.producer ELSE t.producer END, extra_tags = CASE WHEN s.extra_tags IS NOT NULL THEN s.extra_tags ELSE mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.title, s.file_path, s.file_name, s.file_format, s.file_size, s.file_hash, s.fingerprint, s.duration, s.cover_path, s."year", s.bitrate, s.sample_rate, s.channels, s.bits_per_sample, s.language, s.album_id, s.track_number, s.disc_number, s.track_gain, s.track_peak, s.composer, s.lyricist, s.arranger, s.producer, s.extra_tags, s.create_time, s.update_time, sa.artist_id, a.artist_name, al.album_name FROM song s LEFT JOIN song_artist sa ON s.id = sa.song_id LEFT JOIN artist a ON sa.artist_id = a.id LEFT JOIN album al ON s.album_id = al.id WHERE s.id = #{id} ORDER BY sa.sort_order LIMIT 1
